description: EN preamble: company with legal-form suffix but no quotes (normal precision), 'represented by', surname Rose (also a common word: lowercase 'rose' in block 3 is a verb and stays).

blocks.text: This Agreement is made between Northwind Logistics Ltd. (the Supplier), represented by Helen Carter, and John Rose (the Customer).
4.1. Northwind Logistics Ltd. shall not be liable for delays caused by John Rose.
5.2. If the premium rose by more than 5 % the Customer may terminate.
